'''Jeffery Hall''' was a Young Jedi Council Member and the Tatooine Regional Champion in 2000.<ref name="yjiv">[http://www.geocities.com/ev9d11/YoungJedi/Interviews/interviews.htm Deck Effect YJ Interviews], Young Jedi Deck Effect. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20011122015220/http://www.geocities.com/ev9d11/YoungJedi/Interviews/interviews.htm Internet Archive]</ref> In the same interview he compared Decipher's Enhanced Young Jedi products with the Enhanced products for [[Star Wars CCG]].<ref name="yjiv" />

== Interviews ==

=== Young Jedi Deck Effect, 8 July 2000 ===
Interview conducted by Outlander Mercenary ([[Avery Poliak]]) on Young Jedi Deck Effect, the Young Jedi section of [[The Outer Rim (fan site)|The Outer Rim]]. The site labeled him "Tatooine Regionals - 2000."<ref name="yjiv" />

<blockquote>
'''Q. What to your knowledge and opinion do you consider the strongest deck?'''

A. I still think that the strongest deck out there is the Tank Deck. There is simply no other deck that you can build with the fire power and not have to worry about stranding on a site. Because of this you can pack the deck with good Destiny cards and not have to worry about the 2 Destiny of Transports - like you do with say Amidala / Handmaiden Decks and the like.

'''Q. Who so far would you consider your toughest opponent(S) and why?'''

A. I would say that the gang here in Denver are some of the strongest players. Mark, his wife Katie, and Shawn are some of the best players to test new ideas on and play against.

'''Q. What do you consider when building a strong deck, and is it the same style for each deck you build?'''

A. I generally like to make a good, tight theme deck. Whether the theme is Site oriented or Character Oriented it just has to have a good theme. One of the Decks I have used in the Past was based entirely on two Site locations. If I fought on the site location it was not designed for I would stay just long enough for my opponent to place some characters to strand and then surrender and go to another site. Some people forget the importance of surrendering.

'''Q. Is there a certain way that you stack your decks, and if so why?'''

A. Not really, it is just a good shuffle and the old muti-piles that many who played Magic have learned to utilize.

'''Q. Why did you decide to start playing Young Jedi?'''

A. I have been playing CCG ever since there inception and have always enjoyed them. I actully played YJ at the Celebration and was hooked! It was so simple to learn and the ease of play was great. I also liked that I did not already need to have about a million cards to play. I also liked the easy dynamics of it. While YJ is simple in structure it is the Battle Plan that I enjoy the most. It is like a chess game in that you are trying to anticipate what you opponent is going to play and in what position.

'''Q. What are your thoughts of Enhanced Menace set?'''

A. I am glad to see that Decipher is doing positive things to increase the games playability. I loved the enhanced stuff that came out for SWCCG and if they do as good a job on Enhanced Darth Maul as SWCCG it should prove to be a fantastic addition to the game.

'''Q. I have seen the decklists you used. Can you tell us how you came up with those decks?'''

A. Mainly my Dark Side deck was an enhanced version that Shawn and Mark have been playing here in the area. My Light side deck was simply tweaked from the Light Side Deck I used in the State Championships.

'''Q. Do you think they are the best decks for the Tournament Scene right now?'''

A. Who is to say. They may have won this time, but I would say there are weakness's. In fact, against the tank deck an Overrun scheme would be great. I also have to say that Jennifer Niana had a great light side deck that actually defeated the Tank Deck! I may have to playtest it here against some of the other Tank Decks and see how her stategy holds up here - Great Job with the deck Jennifer!

'''Q. Will you be using something similar for the World Events?'''

A. Now why would I want to give that information away.

'''Q. How does it feel to be the Regional Champion?'''

A. Great. It was a challenging event and all the players were extremely good. It will be nice to have the free airfare to Orlando. The only thing I wish was better is greater support from Decipher for the players of this game. The Council Members and the Local Players did a great job hosting the event, I just wish that they had better help from Decipher, like the SWCCG players get to enjoy.
</blockquote>
